source_en: End of rotation. Papers. I cross here twice daily.
Extended perimeter since the [[whisper:eastern incident]]. Clearance should be on file.
Above your clearance. Ask your commanding officer.
No. You get the badge number. Same thing.
This checkpoint runs slower than the eastern one.
Thorough and slow aren't the same. You'll learn. Or you won't.
Fifteen men, twelve-hour cycle. You're costing us minutes. Write that down.
Badge number's on the back. Keep moving.
